system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, Light

Granted power: Once/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Advantage on Craft/Smith checks. Once per encounter, as part of your action, temper an ally's weapon or armour by touch: +1 to hit or +1 AC for 1 minute.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Brigh in the World of Arneyan wiki.
